cases.question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.standalone_question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.answer_excerpt:
COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture is a 3-credit course that focuses on the design, development, and management of web APIs. 

Key topics and learning outcomes of the course include:
- Exploring RESTful APIs, how they relate to HTTP, and why they matter.
- Implementing CRUD operations, error handling, and HTTP status codes.
- Designing and developing programs using REST, JSON, and HTTP, as well as building simple web services.
- Securing backend API servers, implementing secure APIs, and applying change management and versioning.
- Documenting and writing specifications using best practices and REST constraints.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/courses/internet-software-architecture-comp-4537/

cases.question: What are the three main topic areas covered in COMP 1113 Applied Mathematics?
cases.standalone_question: What are the three main topic areas covered in COMP 1113 Applied Mathematics?
cases.answer_excerpt:
COMP 1113 Applied Mathematics covers three main topic areas designed to build a foundation for future technical and programming courses:

*   **Boolean algebra and logic circuit design:** Covers true and false values, basic and derived operators, truth tables, canonical forms, Karnaugh maps, and designing logic circuits like decision systems, adders, comparators, and decoders.
*   **Number systems and data representation:** Explores positional number systems, how numbers, text, and graphics are represented in computers, arithmetic operations across different bases, and various computer representations including complements, excess, BCD, and floating-point.
*   **Functions, linear equations, vectors, and matrices:** Focuses on determining solutions for systems of linear equations, performing basic matrix operations, finding inverses, and utilizing determinants and Cramer's rule.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-systems-technology-diploma-full-time-5500dipma/
- https://www.bcit.ca/courses/applied-mathematics-comp-1113/
- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20261048068/

cases.question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.standalone_question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You are automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan if you are in a program designated as full-time by BCIT that lasts at least 16 weeks. You also have the option to opt out of the plan if you already have comparable extended health and dental coverage.

- **Automatic Enrollment:** Eligible full-time students in technology, trades, or technical studies programs running for 16 weeks or longer are automatically covered, and the Student Association health fee is included in your tuition upon registration.
- **Opt-Out Process:** If you are already covered for comparable extended health and dental benefits, you can decline coverage. The deadline to opt out is 30 days from the start of your program (once per 12 months), and after this deadline, opt-outs cannot be processed.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/
- https://www.bcitsa.ca/student-services/health-dental/

cases.standalone_question: Between COMP 2714 and COMP 4537, how many credits is each course and which one requires COMP 1712?
cases.answer_excerpt:
COMP 2714 is worth 4 credits, COMP 4537 is worth 3 credits, and COMP 2714 requires COMP 1712 as a prerequisite.

- **COMP 2714 (Relational Database Systems):** This course is worth 4.0 credits and lists COMP 1712 as its prerequisite.
- **COMP 4537 (Internet Software Architecture):** This course is worth 3.0 credits and requires COMP 1537 and COMP 3522 as prerequisites instead.

cases.question: Tell me about the Computer Systems Technology diploma at BCIT.
cases.standalone_question: What are the entrance requirements for the Computer Systems Technology diploma at BCIT?

prior_turns.question: Tell me about the Computer Systems Technology diploma at BCIT.

cases.answer_excerpt:
To apply for the full-time Computer Systems Technology (CST) Diploma program, applicants must meet the following entrance requirements:

* **English Language Proficiency:** Category 2 – English Studies 12 with a minimum of 67%, or an equivalent qualification.
* **Mathematics:** Pre-Calculus 12 with a minimum of 67%, or an accepted equivalent BC or Yukon course.

Applicants are accepted on a first-qualified basis as long as space remains, and they must provide proof of meeting all requirements when applying.

Sources:

cases.question: Tell me about the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan.
cases.follow_up: How many days do I have to opt out after my program starts?
cases.standalone_question: How many days do I have to opt out of the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan after my program starts?

prior_turns.question: Tell me about the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan.

cases.answer_excerpt:
You have 30 days from the start of your program to opt out of the student health and dental plan.

- The opt-out and family add-on deadlines are exactly 30 days from the program's start date.
- This option is available once per 12 months for full-time eligible students who already have comparable extended health and dental coverage.
- Deadlines are strict, and opt-outs cannot be processed after this 30-day window closes.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/

cases.question: Does BCIT have student housing?
cases.follow_up: When did the newest residence open?
cases.standalone_question: When did the newest student residence, Tall Timber Student Housing, open at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
The newest BCIT residence, Tall Timber Student Housing, had its grand opening in the summer of 2025 (with rooms opening in Fall 2025).

* The 12-storey building provides 469 beds and features studio suites, private rooms with shared bathrooms and kitchens, and collaboration spaces.
* It combines sustainability and comfort, using mass timber construction and offering priority access for Indigenous students and former youth in care.

prior_turns.question: Which English proficiency categories does BCIT use for admissions?

cases.answer_excerpt:
Category 2 requires a TOEFL iBT overall score of 86 with no section score less than 20 for scores prior to January 21, 2026. As of January 21, 2026, it requires an overall score of 4.5, with scores of 4 in each of the Speaking, Writing, Reading, and Listening sections.
